title: Modules
summary: Turn modules on or off, and find more in the marketplace.

steps.text: {title} lists the modules this company can use. Turn one on to add its screens to the side menu, or off to hide them; turning a module off keeps its records.
{market} lists more modules to add. {build} explains how to write your own on the same public API.
You can also ask the assistant which modules are on, or to turn one on or off. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
